name: outparam_reset
invariant: If a function releases the object an output parameter points to (*P), it must reset *P on every path to function exit.
violation: function exit reachable from a Released state without passing a Reset
notes: No function names appear in the rule except the generic regex for release calls. partial_release_functions is empty on purpose: add an entry only with a code-reading justification recorded in triage.md.
